title: Town Lake Electric Line Hearing Set
summary:
*   Officials convened a brief special meeting to address a single key item.
*   A public hearing was officially scheduled to discuss the granting of an electric line easement.
*   This proposed easement would cross a portion of the North Bank Lake Front Park, commonly known as Town Lake Parkland.
*   The public hearing is set for January 22, 1987, allowing for community input on the potential power line development.

Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of the Council* noting the
